institution.name: The Hague Academy of International Law

qualifications: PhD candidates from non-OECD states currently residing in their home country
Expected thesis defence by 31 December of the year after the award
Undergraduate law degree at minimum; master's preferred
Previous Doctoral Scholarship recipients are ineligible
description_short: The Hague Academy of International Law offers Doctoral Scholarships for PhD candidates from non-OECD states residing in their home country, for a research stay in The Hague from 1 July to 1 September 2027. Applications close 31 January 2027 at 23:59 Hague time.
